protocols.pps: PPS (carga rápida programable, variante de USB-PD)

devices.name: Phone (1)
devices.protocolLabel: USB Power Delivery 3.0 con PPS, hasta 33 W
devices.protocolLabel_en: USB Power Delivery 3.0 with PPS, up to 33 W
devices.advice: Para acercarte a 33 W usa un cargador USB-C PD con PPS de 33 W o más y un cable USB-C a USB-C de 3 A. Con cargadores sin PPS carga más despacio.
devices.advice_en: To get close to 33 W use a USB-C PD charger with PPS rated 33 W or more and a 3 A USB-C to USB-C cable. Chargers without PPS charge more slowly.

devices.name: Phone (2)
devices.protocolLabel: USB Power Delivery 3.0 con PPS, hasta 45 W
devices.protocolLabel_en: USB Power Delivery 3.0 with PPS, up to 45 W
devices.advice: Para acercarte a 45 W usa un cargador USB-C PD con PPS de 45 W (como el Nothing Power 45W) y un cable USB-C a USB-C de 5 A. Con cables de 3 A se queda en torno a 33 W.
devices.advice_en: To get close to 45 W use a 45 W USB-C PD charger with PPS (such as the Nothing Power 45W) and a 5 A USB-C to USB-C cable. With 3 A cables it stays around 33 W.

devices.name: Phone (2a)
devices.protocolLabel: USB Power Delivery 3.0 con PPS, hasta 45 W
devices.protocolLabel_en: USB Power Delivery 3.0 with PPS, up to 45 W
devices.advice: Para acercarte a 45 W usa un cargador USB-C PD con PPS de 45 W y un cable USB-C a USB-C de 5 A. Con cables de 3 A se queda en torno a 33 W. No tiene carga inalámbrica.
devices.advice_en: To get close to 45 W use a 45 W USB-C PD charger with PPS and a 5 A USB-C to USB-C cable. With 3 A cables it stays around 33 W. It has no wireless charging.
